manifest.description: Extract inline Vaadin dialog creation/opening logic into a dedicated Dialog subclass with optional provider wiring.
when_to_use: a Vaadin view builds dialogs inline or keeps dialog fields only for open and close coordination
dialog-owned binder, save, cancel, or listener setup should live in a typed Dialog class
anti_patterns: do not move dialog save/cancel code that mutates caller state without explicit callbacks/public API
do not create singleton dialogs for UI/session scoped state

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-extract-dialog-class. Charter: move one dialog-owned creation/opening surface into a dedicated Dialog class.

Protocol:
1. Ground: bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}").
2. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_extract_dialog_class", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", item_names={{item_names}}, old_text="{{old_text}}", move_fields={{move_fields}}, provider_field="{{provider_field}}", base_class="{{base_class}}", public_methods={{public_methods}}).
3. Block if caller state mutation lacks public_methods/callback acknowledgement, listener cleanup is lost, or dialog dependencies have unmodeled UI/session scope.
4. Apply only when inputs.apply is true via bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent", confirm=true, steps=[<java_vaadin_extract_dialog_class plan step>, <validation command from validation_cmd>]).
5. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line dialog class, provider/direct wiring, moved members, applied/planned>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{item_names}} {{old_text}} {{move_fields}} {{provider_field}} {{base_class}} {{public_methods}} {{apply}} {{validation_cmd}}
